Ticket.Title: Add a retry policy to the notification worker
Ticket.Description: Wraps the provider client's send call in an exponential-backoff retry policy with a jittered delay. Acceptance: a transient provider failure is retried up to three times before the event is dead-lettered.

Comments.Author: programmer
Comments.Body: Delivered. Changed files: src/Worker/RetryPolicy.cs, src/Worker/NotificationClient.cs, tests/Worker/RetryPolicyTests.cs.
